title: Depth-Based Local Recentering of Maxmin Landmarks for Lazy Witness Persistence
summary: We study a local post-processing rule for maxmin (farthest-point) landmark selection in lazy witness persistence. Maxmin landmarks induce nearest-landmark cells. Within each cell, the landmark is moved toward a data point of maximum empirical halfspace depth, with smaller moves in sparsely populated cells, and is then projected back to a data point in the same cell. The resulting support-weighted rule preserves one landmark per original maxmin cell.
